mapper.insert: /* net.dstone.boot.common.messaging.outbox.OutboxDao.insert */ INSERT INTO TB_OUTBOX_MESSAGE (TOPIC, MSG_KEY, PAYLOAD, STATUS, RETRY_CNT) VALUES (#{TOPIC}, #{MSG_KEY}, #{PAYLOAD}, #{STATUS}, 0)
mapper.update: /* net.dstone.boot.common.messaging.outbox.OutboxDao.claim */ UPDATE TB_OUTBOX_MESSAGE SET STATUS = 'SENDING' , DISPATCH_TOKEN = #{DISPATCH_TOKEN} , DISPATCHED_DT = NOW() WHERE 1=1 AND STATUS = 'PENDING' ORDER BY ID ASC LIMIT #{LIMIT}
mapper.select: /* net.dstone.boot.common.messaging.outbox.OutboxDao.findByDispatchToken */ SELECT ID, TOPIC, MSG_KEY, PAYLOAD, STATUS, RETRY_CNT FROM TB_OUTBOX_MESSAGE WHERE 1=1 AND STATUS = 'SENDING' AND DISPATCH_TOKEN = #{DISPATCH_TOKEN} ORDER BY ID ASC
mapper.update: /* net.dstone.boot.common.messaging.outbox.OutboxDao.markSent */ UPDATE TB_OUTBOX_MESSAGE SET STATUS = 'SENT' , SENT_DT = NOW() WHERE 1=1 AND ID = #{ID}

/* net.dstone.boot.common.messaging.outbox.OutboxDao.requeueStale */ UPDATE TB_OUTBOX_MESSAGE SET STATUS = 'PENDING' WHERE 1=1 AND STATUS = 'SENDING' AND DISPATCHED_DT < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{STALE_SECONDS} SECOND)
